title: 鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架~Steel-rib and lattice-girder tunnel support
focus: 把鋼拱、格柵、噴凝土與基腳組成可驗證支護系統~Combine steel ribs, lattices, shotcrete and feet into a verifiable support system
summary: 本課以把鋼拱、格柵、噴凝土與基腳組成可驗證支護系統為主線，從榀距與分擔寬度與軸力偏心與彎矩建立系統邊界，再把接頭滑移與力線連續、複合噴層與變形相容連到隱蔽工程與交接追溯。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on combine steel ribs, lattices, shotcrete and feet into a verifiable support system. It begins with Rib spacing and tributary width and Axial eccentricity and bending, links Joint slip and force continuity and Composite shotcrete and compatibility, and ends with Concealed works and handover traceability. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 榀距與分擔寬度~Rib spacing and tributary width
units.title: 榀距與分擔寬度~Rib spacing and tributary width
units.mechanism: 相鄰鋼拱間距決定單榀承受的地層分擔寬度，間距增加同時拉大噴層縱向跨距。完整圓環均壓可估環向軸力，但局部鬆動塊會引入彎矩；應分開平均地層壓力與集中作用，不能只以環力判斷全部構件。 判別這個機制時，應觀察沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度；若出現局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Spacing determines each rib's tributary ground width and the longitudinal span of shotcrete. Uniform pressure on an intact ring estimates hoop thrust, but loose blocks introduce bending. Separate average ground pressure from concentrated actions rather than treating ring thrust as the complete member demand. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness. If a locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 軸力偏心與彎矩~Axial eccentricity and bending
units.title: 軸力偏心與彎矩~Axial eccentricity and bending
units.mechanism: 鋼拱與岩面接觸不均會使壓力偏離截面中心，名義壓縮構件因而同時彎曲。接頭與基腳的旋轉也會移動作用線，不能用截面積增加掩蓋偏心；應先辨識接觸點及變形後幾何，再決定是否需二階分析。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照鋼拱斷面掃描、接觸點及內外緣應變差；若出現只看平均壓應變漏掉單側拉應力與局部屈曲，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Uneven ground contact moves force away from the section centre and bends a nominal compression member. Joint and foot rotation also move the load line. Increasing area does not resolve eccentricity; identify contact locations and deformed geometry before deciding on second-order analysis. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare rib geometry, contact points and differences between inner and outer strains. If mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 鋼拱弱軸與有效長度~Weak-axis buckling and effective length
units.title: 鋼拱弱軸與有效長度~Weak-axis buckling and effective length
units.mechanism: 拱面內有支承不代表拱面外也被約束，縱向連繫的位置決定弱軸有效長度。Euler 公式只適用理想彈性直柱，彎曲拱架還有初始缺陷和非均勻受力；它適合揭示連繫缺失的敏感度，不應當成實際承載保證。 判別這個機制時，應觀察查核連繫間距、接頭固定度及拱面外偏移量；若出現缺少一段連繫讓有效長度倍增，理想屈曲力降至四分之一，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~In-plane restraint does not establish out-of-plane restraint; longitudinal ties control weak-axis effective length. Euler's ideal straight-column model omits curved geometry, imperfections and nonuniform force. It reveals sensitivity to missing ties rather than guaranteeing actual rib resistance. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check tie spacing, connection restraint and out-of-plane offsets. If one missing tie bay doubles effective length and quarters ideal buckling force, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Pcr=pi^2*E*I/L^2=pi^2*200 GPa*2e-6 m4/(2 m)^2=987 kN。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Pcr=pi^2*E*I/L^2=pi^2*200 GPa*2e-6 m4/(2 m)^2=987 kN. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 格柵桁架與節點~Lattice trusses and nodes
units.title: 格柵桁架與節點~Lattice trusses and nodes
units.mechanism: 格柵以主筋和腹桿形成小型桁架，節點把剪力傳到弦材。若腹桿焊接缺陷或幾何偏差存在，名義鋼量相同仍有不同剛度；噴凝土填滿格柵後才可能建立預期複合作用，不能忽略空隙與施工前裸架狀態。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性；若出現節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~A lattice transfers shear through webs into chord bars. Weld defects or geometric deviations change stiffness despite equal steel mass. Intended composite action requires shotcrete to fill the lattice, while voids and the exposed pre-encapsulation stage remain distinct structural states. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation. If a detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：chordForce=M/h=9 kNm/0.30 m=30 kN in an ideal chord pair。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: chordForce=M/h=9 kNm/0.30 m=30 kN in an ideal chord pair. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 接頭滑移與力線連續~Joint slip and force continuity
units.title: 接頭滑移與力線連續~Joint slip and force continuity
units.mechanism: 分段鋼拱的接頭必須傳遞設計所需軸力與彎矩，接觸間隙可能讓兩側先後受力。螺栓鎖緊不是連續剛接的證明，滑移後作用線還會偏移；應把接頭剛度與允許變形列入整榀模型，而非把接頭當成無長度連線。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變；若出現接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Segment joints must transfer the required thrust and moment, but gaps engage the two sides at different times. Tight bolts do not prove rigid continuity, and slip moves the load line. Include joint stiffness and deformation in the rib model rather than an ideal zero-length connection. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides. If joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 基腳承載與沉陷~Foot bearing and settlement
units.title: 基腳承載與沉陷~Foot bearing and settlement
units.mechanism: 鋼拱荷載最後由基腳傳入地層，鬆軟或受水擾動的基底可能先於鋼材屈服。基腳沉陷會使拱形變扁並增加彎曲，單側沉陷尤其不利；擴大底板也需確認真正接觸面積，不能把懸空板面列入承壓。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以基腳水準、接觸印跡及地層含水狀態同步追蹤；若出現單側基腳下陷使拱頂偏移，構件強度合格仍失穩，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Footings transfer rib actions into ground that may soften or erode before steel yields. Settlement flattens the arch and increases bending, especially if asymmetric. Larger plates help only where contact exists; unsupported plate area cannot be counted as bearing area. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Track foot levels, contact marks and ground moisture together. If one sinking foot displaces the crown and destabilizes otherwise adequate members, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：q=N/A=240 kN/0.40 m2=600 kPa。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: q=N/A=240 kN/0.40 m2=600 kPa. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: One sinking foot displaces the crown and destabilizes otherwise adequate members. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 單側基腳下陷使拱頂偏移，構件強度合格仍失穩。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以基腳水準、接觸印跡及地層含水狀態同步追蹤，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~One sinking foot displaces the crown and destabilizes otherwise adequate members. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to track foot levels, contact marks and ground moisture together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 鋼材強度合格就不需要驗算拱架基腳~Adequate steel strength removes the need to assess rib feet
units.practice: 將以基腳水準、接觸印跡及地層含水狀態同步追蹤列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現單側基腳下陷使拱頂偏移，構件強度合格仍失穩，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Track foot levels, contact marks and ground moisture together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If one sinking foot displaces the crown and destabilizes otherwise adequate members, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 複合噴層與變形相容~Composite shotcrete and compatibility
units.title: 複合噴層與變形相容~Composite shotcrete and compatibility
units.mechanism: 鋼拱與噴凝土只有在接觸及剪力傳遞足夠時才能共同分擔荷載。材料模數與齡期不同，先受力的鋼拱不會因後續噴層硬化而自動卸載；組合剛度只是同時變形下的理想上限，須保留實際施工載入歷史。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對時比較鋼材和噴層應變及各自開始受力時刻；若出現把全部荷載按完工剛度重分配會低估鋼拱既有應力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Steel and shotcrete share loads only with sufficient contact and shear transfer. Their moduli and ages differ, and steel loaded earlier does not automatically unload as shotcrete hardens. Combined stiffness is an ideal compatibility model requiring the actual staged loading history. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare steel and shotcrete strains with their respective loading-start times. If redistributing all load by final stiffness understates stress already carried by steel, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：EAsteel=200 GPa*0.003 m2=600 MN; EAshotcrete=10 GPa*0.10 m2=1000 MN。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: EAsteel=200 GPa*0.003 m2=600 MN; EAshotcrete=10 GPa*0.10 m2=1000 MN. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 輪廓測量與二階效應~Profile survey and second-order response
units.title: 輪廓測量與二階效應~Profile survey and second-order response
units.mechanism: 拱架初始偏位與後續收斂會改變軸力作用線，附加彎矩與軸力及偏移成正比。位移小不代表可忽略，因為壓力可能很大；量測應分開安裝誤差與荷載造成的變形，否則模型初始幾何與監測零點彼此矛盾。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用安裝後基準斷面比較各時期冠頂與側壁偏移；若出現重設量測零點掩蓋累積偏位，低估二階彎矩，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Initial offsets and convergence move the thrust line, creating an added moment proportional to force and displacement. Small motion may matter under large compression. Separate installation error from load-induced deformation so model geometry and monitoring zero do not contradict one another. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare crown and wall offsets against the as-installed reference section. If resetting the survey zero hides accumulated offset and understates second-order moment, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Msecond=P*delta=300 kN*0.020 m=6 kNm。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Msecond=P*delta=300 kN*0.020 m=6 kNm. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 腐蝕與未包覆區~Corrosion and uncovered zones
units.title: 腐蝕與未包覆區~Corrosion and uncovered zones
units.mechanism: 拱架接頭、基腳及噴層空洞是容易接觸水氣的位置，腐蝕往往不是沿整榀均勻分布。厚度減少會同時影響面積與局部板件穩定，不能只用外表鏽色分級；檢查位置應與漏水和原施工空鼓紀錄互相連結。 判別這個機制時，應觀察在接頭及濕區量測剩餘厚度，配對空鼓與漏水圖；若出現隱藏空洞持續進水造成局部減薄，外露乾區卻正常，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Joints, feet and shotcrete voids expose ribs to moisture, producing localized rather than uniform corrosion. Thickness loss affects both area and local plate stability; rust colour alone is insufficient. Relate inspection positions to leakage and original void records. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure remaining thickness at joints and wet zones against void and leakage maps. If wet hidden cavities thin local steel while exposed dry areas appear sound, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 隱蔽工程與交接追溯~Concealed works and handover traceability
units.title: 隱蔽工程與交接追溯~Concealed works and handover traceability
units.mechanism: 噴層完成後接頭、連繫及基腳難以直接觀察，施工前照片和幾何紀錄具有不可替代性。單一材料證書只能說明鋼材供應，不能證明現地連接；交接須把每榀編號連到檢查結果和修補版本，讓後續異常能定位到特定構造。 判別這個機制時，應觀察按榀號核對接頭、連繫、基腳與包覆前照片；若出現無法定位的施工照片使缺失區域無從追查與維修，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Encapsulation hides joints, ties and feet, making pre-cover photographs and geometry irreplaceable. A mill certificate describes supplied steel rather than installed connections. Link every rib identifier to inspections and repair revisions so later anomalies can be traced to the actual detail. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit joints, ties, feet and pre-cover photographs by rib identifier. If unlocated construction photographs prevent tracing and repairing a defective zone, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：traceability=fullyLinkedRibs/installedRibs=46/50=92 percent。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: traceability=fullyLinkedRibs/installedRibs=46/50=92 percent. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查榀距與分擔寬度：N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN；再獨立檢查軸力偏心與彎矩：M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm。間距由 0.75 增為 1.0 m，在壓力 0.08 MPa、半徑 4 m 的理想環模型下，單榀環力由 240 增為 320 kN；噴層跨距效應另算。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 將用安裝後基準斷面比較各時期冠頂與側壁偏移作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Rib spacing and tributary width: N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN. Independently check Axial eccentricity and bending: M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm. Increasing spacing from 0.75 to 1.0 m at pressure 0.08 MPa and radius 4 m raises ideal rib thrust from 240 to 320 kN; shotcrete span effects require separate assessment. The two results are not a complete design because a rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. Use compare crown and wall offsets against the as-installed reference section as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的把鋼拱、格柵、噴凝土與基腳組成可驗證支護系統，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on combine steel ribs, lattices, shotcrete and feet into a verifiable support system reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
